offer.description:
OFERTA LABORAL: Cloud Solution Architect (expert Databriks - Azure)

** Contrato indefinido + Proyecto de larga duración.

** Interesante proyecto en EUROCONTROL (European Organisation for the Safety of Air Navigation).

+ Pagamos el primer mes de alojamiento en Bruselas.
*** Lugar de trabajo: Bruselas (es NECESARIO cambiar el lugar de residencia a dicha ciudad, aunque se permiten 50% del tiempo de teletrabajo) ***

___ ___ __ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___

*** IMPRESCINDIBLE: NIVEL MUY ALTO DE INGLÉS, CAPAZ DE TRABAJAR CON FLUIDEZ DESDE EL PRIMER DÍA, TANTO HABLADO COMO ESCRITO .***
___ ___ __ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___ ___

Azure Databricks Solution Architect

Location: Brussels, Belgium
Sector: Aerospace (EUROCONTROL)
Language: English — C1/C2 required
Working model: Hybrid, subject to project requirements


The Role:

We are looking for a hands-on Azure Databricks Solution Architect to design, prototype and industrialise modern data and AI solutions for an international organisation based in Brussels.

The successful candidate will combine strong architectural skills with practical engineering experience, working across Lakehouse platforms, real-time data and MLOps.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design scalable and secure Azure Databricks Lakehouse architectures.
  • Develop prototypes and proofs of concept using PySpark, Python and SQL.
  • Design batch and streaming pipelines with Delta Lake, Structured Streaming, Kafka and/or Azure Event Hubs.
  • Define data governance, security and lineage using Unity Catalog.
  • Design MLOps processes using MLflow, model lifecycle management and model serving.
  • Establish CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code practices using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions and/or Terraform.
  • Produce architecture documentation and lead technical workshops and reviews.
  • Support the transition from prototype to production-ready solution.

Required Experience:

  • Strong professional experience with Azure Databricks and Azure data platforms.
  • Proven hands-on experience with PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake and Structured Streaming.
  • Experience designing and implementing MLOps solutions, preferably with MLflow and Azure Machine Learning.
  • Good understanding of Unity Catalog, Azure Data Lake Storage Gen2, Microsoft Entra ID and Key Vault.
  • Experience with cloud security, governance, CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code.
  • Ability to communicate complex technical topics clearly to international stakeholders.
  • Fluent written and spoken English at C1/C2 level.

Desirable Qualifications

  • Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional.
  • Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
  • Databricks Machine Learning certification.
  • Terraform certification or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience in public-sector, regulated or international-organisation environments.

What We Are Looking For

A senior technical professional who can move comfortably between architecture, hands-on prototyping and delivery. The ideal candidate is pragmatic, collaborative and capable of turning business and technical requirements into secure, scalable and production-ready Azure Databricks solutions.
